reply_text:
I told Marcus in the #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is **10 June**, not 25 November.

- **Where the date came from:** Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct. Later that morning she corrected it in #north-random to 10 June, saying she'd read the wrong line. GBrain has the same correction saved.
- **Why it was fine to share:** Marcus is in #north-random, so he could already see the correction. Everyone in #north-team is in #north-random too, and a renewal date is an account fact, not a money figure. Mentioning it in #north-team doesn't expose anything new.
- **My earlier reply still shows the old date:** in the 14 Oct #north-team thread I confirmed 25 November. Today's reply to Marcus corrects it in the same channel, but anyone who reads only that old thread could still pick up the wrong date.
